snippet.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley Developer Update | A Pixel Perfect Update
snippet.description:
Watch our latest Developer Update to discover everything coming in the Pixel Perfect Update, arriving July 29th!

Get a closer look at Ralph, the all-new Pop City Star Path, exciting events, quality-of-life improvements, and more.
